text:
Ellen: Heads-up everyone  Samir submitted his resignation today. Last active day will be 2027-02-12. Need to lock in benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, equipment return, and transfer of on-call rota.

Gwen: From benefits side  coverage runs through 2027-02-28 (end of month). COBRA vendor sends election notice 2027-03-01 and employee has 60 days to elect. I'll DM the details and include a rough monthly premium estimate.

Ellen: Payroll question  Samir is UK-based contractor transitioned to payroll in 2024. Priya, is there extra steps for local benefits or taxable accruals?

HR-bot: Payroll ops reminder created: PAY-9123  process final pay and any accrued leave per local law.

Gwen: Also check his cycle for company pension opt-out or auto-enrolment reversal. I'll coordinate with benefits vendor.

Samir: Id prefer to ship the laptop back via our courier. Please don't disable Slack until 2/13 so I can complete handover notes.

IT-Jules: Okta: samir@redwood.com. Laptop serial: LPT-77823. Hes owner on oncall schedule "search-team" and has deploy keys to repo search-backend. I'll file ticket and propose deprovision steps.

Ellen: Can we schedule deprovision for 2027-02-13 09:00 GMT to allow him to finish morning handover?

IT-Jules: Plan: 02/13 09:00 GMT  suspend Okta SSO & revoke sessions; 09:15 remove deploy keys and rotate any service account keys he created; 10:00 remove oncall schedule membership and reassign to gwen@; will attach runbook to IT-4902.

Gwen: Ill pick up oncall and add Jenna as primary for the next two weeks. Also will request a pager duty handover doc from Samir by 02/11.

Samir: I'll post a short runbook by EOD 02/10 and DM Jules about courier pickup time. Thanks.

Ellen: TL;DR  Gwen sends COBRA/pension notes 03/01, PAY-9123 for payroll finalization, IT-4902 will manage deprovision on 02/13, Samir to ship laptop with courier and provide handover doc by 02/11. I'll schedule a 20-min exit chat on 02/11 afternoon.

Samir: Exit chat confirmed 02/11 15:00 GMT for me. Appreciate the clear plan.

HR-bot: Created offboarding checklist OBF-212: benefits, payroll, IT deprovision, assets, exit interview.
